property_summary: The reference requires every low-level transferFrom call to succeed, so reverting callees make transfer revert and prevent any caller-observable success; the mutant replaces require(_s) with require(true), allowing transfer to return true even when a callee fails.
change_summary: Replace the require(_s) success check with a require(true), so failed low-level calls no longer cause a revert.
